title: SIGNAL eef-revalidate-on-new-graph-tools: G3 thread-progressions contract replaced (PR #164, head 6ec06167)
body: Per the plan's signal-eef-revalidation todo: get-thread-progressions is rewritten anchored+bounded (threadSlug detail returning ONE thread's year-ordered progression, or subject+keyStage discovery returning bounded descriptors; year-axis semantics stated in the contract — the bulk exports no within-thread unit ordering, ruling 215b08d2). curriculum://thread-progressions REMOVED. The value re-proof is owned by eef-revalidate-on-new-graph-tools. NOTE for that re-proof: the prerequisiteFor year-axis re-chain (ruled (a), owner-visible merge) lands as a SEPARATE follow-on PR and will raise its own signal naming the re-chain.
